title: Jerk Chicken Pizza with Mango Salsa
equipment: Large baking sheet or 12-inch pizza pan

items: ¼ cup grated Asiago cheese (about ¾ oz)
¼ cup shredded mozzarella cheese (about 1 oz)
¼ cup grated smoked mozzarella cheese (about 1 oz)
½ ripe mango, peeled and diced
1 tsp chopped fresh mint, basil, cilantro or a mix of all three

steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Set the pizza crust on a large baking sheet or 12-inch pizza pan.

Rub the jerk seasoning all over the chicken. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Cook the chicken 5 to 7 min per side, until browned and an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 165°F. Move it to a cutting board and let it rest 5 min.
Add the mushrooms to the same skillet and cook over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 min, stirring, until they soften. Tip out any liquid in the pan.
Slice the rested chicken into thin strips.
In a small mixing bowl, stir together the mango, red onion, tomato, 1 tbsp olive oil, balsamic vinegar and herbs until well mixed.
Spread the barbecue sauce over the crust, leaving a ½-inch border. Top with the mushrooms and chicken strips, then scatter the Asiago, mozzarella and smoked mozzarella over everything.
Bake 7 to 8 min, until the crust edges are browned and the cheese is golden and bubbling.
Spoon the mango salsa over the hot pizza right away, slice and serve.
tips: Pound the chicken breast to an even ¾-inch thickness so it cooks through without drying out.
Make the salsa up to 2 hr ahead and keep it chilled; stir before using.
Rotisserie chicken works in a pinch; toss the strips with the jerk seasoning instead of searing.
storage: Refrigerate leftover pizza up to 3 days and the salsa separately up to 2 days. Reheat slices on a baking sheet at 400°F for 6 to 8 min until hot. The pizza does not freeze well once topped with salsa.
